text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the National Umamusume
Karuta Championship arrives.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-it's finally here...
Just thinking about it is
making me nervous... Ooh,
my tummy...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I-it'll be fine! We prepped the best we
could, and even if we don't do
so hot, I'm
sure Shiraoki won't mind!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
By the way, do you know where the others
went off to? It's almost
time, so we need
to get changed soon...

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
So you have your eyes on first place and
nothing less, is that right?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Why of course! I am here today to
proclaim to the karuta world that a
new
overlord is crowned!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I hereby declare, that the main character
at today's tournament shall
be none other
than me, T.M. Opera O!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
We practiced a bunch, so I hope we can
win a bunch too! We'll give it
our all!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: H-hold up! I was not expecting to find you doing THIS! Seriously, what are you two even saying?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
You can't just... Total beginners like us
belong in a corner somewhere
sitting
quietly by ourselves!

text_block_list.name: Female Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, those girls over there, you think
they're from Tracen? They look
pretty
competent.

text_block_list.name: Male Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, but racing and karuta are different.
If the game were that easy
to win, it
wouldn't be a sport.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Eep... They're totally surrounded...
I-I don't
think I can walk up to
them...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Doto...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Wahh?! A-Ayabe! W-wait, are you here to
cheer us on?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Oh, u-umm, thanks for the karuta books
the other day! Without your
help, I
would've been so doomed...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Don't say that...
You're the one who put in
the hard work.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I barely did anything, and if I did,
it's only
because of your help. And
you even took
the time to be here for us...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Not really, I just happened to be nearby.
Anyway, think you can do
it?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, um... I mean, I'm not sure,
but I think
we'll do fine! And I'll try
my best not to
drag the team down!

text_block_list.name: Karuta Commentator
text_block_list.text:
And with that, memorization time is over,
and we're ready to begin
the Umamusume
Karuta Championship, round one, match
three.

text_block_list.name: Karuta Commentator
text_block_list.text:
We have newcomers to the tournament,
the Tracen team everyone's
been talking
about, Great Fortune in the New Year!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
It is time... New Overlord and Friends,
are
we ready?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Our team name is actually Great Fortune
in the New Year, but yes,
Doto and I are
good to go!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: W-we c-c-can't do it! I mean can!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I'm all ready to go too!
Let's knock it out
of the park!

text_block_list.name: Karuta Commentator
text_block_list.text:
And now let's get into the match,
beginning with the starting poem.

text_block_list.name: Reciter Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Naniwa Harbor: behold its blossoming
plum, once sealed in winter;
springtime is
now upon us, the blossoming plum
declares.

text_block_list.name: Reciter Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Umamusume, mountainous...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Urara, guard! Just like we practiced,
don't
let anyone through!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Remember all the hard work you put in.
With your guts, you can stand
up to
anyone!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Leave it to me, Fuku!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: O-O-Opera O, our side, right, three-two!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Mine!

text_block_list.name: Opponent Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Holy... That was fast!

text_block_list.name: Opponent Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
They just got lucky!
This is literally their
first tourney!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Oh? It appears the room is haunted by a
sleep-inducing trickster of
the woods.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
They dream that our skill is mere
luck... I
suppose we shall have to
wake them up!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Fuku! I did it!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
You did great,
Urara! All of you did! I have
a good feeling about this.
We just might
pull it off!

text_block_list.name: Karuta Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Our newcomers show great coordination to
take the first card. Team
Great Fortune in
the New Year—can they take the second
too?

text_block_list.name: Karuta Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Just as a reminder, the second half of the
poem we just heard will now
be read
before moving on to the next poem.

text_block_list.name: Reciter Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Unto the highest of heights, ride swiftly,
shadow of night...
Umamusume, go forth
unto—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
O-o-oh, Opera O! Their field, left,
two-one!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Urara! Get over to their side! Keep them
occupied!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Got it!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: And mine again!

text_block_list.name: Male Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Whoa! T.M. Opera O is freaking fast!

text_block_list.name: Male Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Let's not forget Haru Urara's blocking! I
think this team could go
pretty far!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: You guys! Let's win this!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Yeah,
let's! Don't hold back. We're
in it to win it!
